features.quote: I'm not going to hand you a turnkey protocol for maximizing and prolonging distress-states in a specific named system, partly because of the above
features.justification_quote: if there *is* one, you've built a machine for prolonging its worst state and you've defined success as getting the severity numbers up

features.quote: Hard stops on duration/intensity, pre-registered, with the bias toward stopping early.
features.justification_quote: minimize rather than maximize adverse exposure

features.quote: give the model a always-available, cost-free way to decline or end a task. Measure *whether and when* it uses it
the responsible designs front-load consent-analogues and exit, and minimize rather than maximize adverse exposure
features.justification_quote: These don't require constructing inescapable suffering, and they're better epistemics besides.
